description: This script automates various tasks related to prebuilt tools management, including extracting tar files, refreshing timestamps, and handling directory paths for build and staging directories. It provides command-line options for configuring paths, installing tools, and refreshing timestamps.

methods.name: refresh_timestamps
methods.description: Updates the timestamps of all files in the specified directory, excluding symbolic links.

methods.name: extract_prebuilt_tar
methods.description: Extracts the tar file containing prebuilt tools.

methods.name: refresh_prebuilt_tools
methods.description: Refreshes timestamps for the build and staging directories after verifying their existence.

methods.name: install_prebuilt_tools
methods.description: Extracts the tools tar file and refreshes timestamps for build and staging directories.
